resolutions.researcher_notes:
[GANZHOU-SOUTH-FUELSOURCE-RULING-2026-09-10] ORCHESTRATOR RULING -- ONE BRANCH, TWO SOURCES. The four Ganzhou South Branch rows (P4785 大余-信丰段, P4786 会昌-寻乌段, P4787 龙南-全南段, P4788 信丰-瑞金段) are segments of one hydraulically connected branch fed at both ends, so FuelSource on all four is 'West-East Gas Pipeline 2, West-East Gas Pipeline 3' and the 川气东送 half of the sheet's P4787/P4788 value is dropped. Sourcing: the operator's own 2024 emergency plan states the branch's sources exhaustively as 西二线149#阀室 (Dayu) 或 西三线瑞金分输清管站, in the document that names three of these four segments, and 川气东送 does not occur once in its 321 pages; the 2021 江西日报/江西发布 announcement names all eight supplied counties off the Ruijin WEP3 station with the Dayu WEP2 tie-in as the second, then-future source and 双气源双向供气 as the end state; and 全南县's own 2024 reply records WEP2 as the gas the county actually started taking at end-2022. CCXI 2022 assigns 川气东送 to the PHASE I provincial network (天然气管道公司) while these are Phase II rows (管道分公司, 承接西气东输二线气源). The order is NUMERIC convention and the live sheet's own -- sibling P4789 already reads 'West-East Gas Pipeline 2, West-East Gas Pipeline 3, Sichuan-Shanghai Gas Pipeline' -- not a primacy claim: realized-vs-designed differs by end (会昌/寻乌 took WEP3 from 2021, 全南 took WEP2 from end-2022) and splitting the value per segment would publish an inference the operator's own 「或」 does not support. THIS ROW: A NEW RECORD. This unit had no shard record at all -- only the ref_shards_recovery entry headed 'CONTRADICTION -- DO NOT TREAT AS CONFIRMATORY', whose single thepaper ref verified contains_value:false because it was checked against the OLD sheet value ('Sichuan-Shanghai gas pipeline/West-East gas pipeline II'), which that page indeed does not state. merge_qc therefore stripped the ref and the unit delivered UNRESOLVED with none, leaving the live value uncited on the paste surface -- the rule-4(e) defect. THAT FRAMING IS SUPERSEDED, not overruled: the recovery record's reading of its own source was right, and its recommendation ('recommend checking whether Sichuan-Shanghai … should read West-East gas pipeline III instead') is what this ruling acts on. Against the NEW value the same page does state the trunks, so contains_value is true -- a different question, re-asked, not a hand-flipped flag. Also supersedes __VALIDITY__ item (4)'s interim recommendation that 'the sheet's existing Sichuan-Shanghai gas pipeline/West-East gas pipeline II is the better-supported reading': item (4) was right that the WEP3 evidence then in hand came from articles about the sibling 信丰-瑞金段, and right to escalate rather than apply v2's proposal blindly -- but the operator plan names 龙南-全南段 itself and gives BOTH trunks, and 川气东送 appears nowhere in it, so no part of the sheet's value survives except the WEP2 half. Three publishers here: operator plan (segment), 2021 announcement (names 龙南、全南), 全南县 housing bureau (names the county, records WEP2 as what actually arrived end-2022). --- SUPERSEDED RECOVERY RECORD (its own text follows, kept verbatim as provenance; its 'CONTRADICTION -- DO NOT TREAT AS CONFIRMATORY' heading and its merge-time independence bracket describe the question as it stood before this ruling): CONTRADICTION -- DO NOT TREAT AS CONFIRMATORY. This is the strongest, most directly on-point source I could find naming Longnan/Quannan's actual gas source, and it CONTRADICTS the recorded FuelSource. The recorded value is 'Sichuan-Shanghai gas pipeline/West-East gas pipeline II' (川气东送/西气东输二线) -- two DIFFERENT, unrelated trunks (川气东送 is a separate Sinopec-operated line; West-East Line II is a PetroChina/PipeChina trunk distinct from West-East Line III). The source found (thepaper.cn baijiahao_12058235, sourced to the official 江西发布 provincial account) states the Ganzhou South Branch -- explicitly including Longnan and Quannan by name -- is fed from the Ruijin distribution station off WEST-EAST GAS PIPELINE LINE III (西气东输三线), with West-East Line II described only as a FUTURE (not-yet-built, as of 2021) secondary/dual-sourcing connection via a valve chamber in Dayu county -- and Sichuan-Shanghai gas pipeline is not mentioned at all in this network's sourcing. I also found a near-duplicate republication of the same underlying story on pipechina.com.cn (https://www.pipechina.com.cn/front/news/1914.html, source 手机江西台 2021-03-18) but it does NOT name Longnan or Quannan anywhere, so it fails the 'must name the segment' rule (4a) as a standalone ref for this row and is not included as a citation -- it is offered here only as background corroboration that the underlying West-East-Line-III-to-Ganzhou-South-Branch story is a real, multiply-reported event, not a one-off error. Per standing instruction (mirroring the P4786 Status case): the recorded value is NOT changed here (values field kept verbatim), the ref is still emitted as a record rather than left UNRESOLVED because a specific, well-sourced answer WAS found -- it simply disagrees with the sheet. Flagging prominently for human review: recommend checking whether 'Sichuan-Shanghai gas pipeline/West-East gas pipeline II' is actually correct, or whether it should read 'West-East gas pipeline III' instead. Tier medium: one strong primary/official-sourced article, but it contradicts rather than confirms, and I did not find a second source that agrees with EITHER the recorded value or my contradicting finding.
